$comment: Deliberate holds for scripts/check-versions.mjs. Anything newer than a hold is reported as 'held', not as an upgrade to do. Remove an entry when the reason stops applying.

node.reason: Stay on 22 LTS until after 0.2.x; 24 (V8 13.6) deferred on purpose

tauriCef.reason: alpha.27 decouples the runtime; deferred until after 0.2.x. macos-fps stays vendored

@types/node.reason: Types must follow the Node major we run (22)

ubuntu.reason: The Flatpak binary is built on the runner and runs on the runtime's glibc, so runner glibc must not exceed the runtime's (22.04: 2.35, 24.04: 2.39; runtime 24.08 believed 2.40, 25.08 is 2.42). 26.04 only after the runtime moves up
